description: Implementation of the ProductRelationshipService interface managing product relationships, groups, and related operations within the sales manager system.

classes.name: ProductRelationshipServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for managing product relationships, including adding, retrieving, activating, deactivating, and deleting relationship groups and individual relationships.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new product relationship or updates an existing one based on whether the ID is present.

methods.name: addGroup
methods.description: Creates a new product relationship group for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all relationship groups associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: deleteGroup
methods.description: Deletes all relationships within a specified group for a merchant store.

methods.name: deactivateGroup
methods.description: Deactivates all relationships within a specified group for a merchant store.

methods.name: activateGroup
methods.description: Activates all relationships within a specified group for a merchant store.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific product relationship after re-fetching it to avoid detached entity errors.

methods.name: listByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves all relationships associated with a particular product.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves relationships filtered by store, product, relationship type, and language, or other combinations.

methods.name: getByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves all relationships belonging to a specific group within a store.
